fields.label: Lesson
fields.description: The lesson this chapter belongs to. Chapters hang off (lesson, block_key) exactly as checkpoints do — Training Content Block is itself a child table, and Frappe has no grandchild tables.

fields.label: Course Version
fields.description: Denormalised from the lesson so a version's chapters can be found without a join.

fields.label: Block Key
fields.description: The video block. A STABLE key, never an idx: reordering blocks must not move a chapter onto a different video.

fields.label: At (Seconds)
fields.description: Where the chapter starts. Seeking here earns no watch coverage — forward seek never has — so chapter-jumping cannot be used to pass a gated course.
